bank-bins.what: Card BIN (first 6 digits) to bank name
bank-bins.publisher: No official list found. An entry needs two agreeing public sources (two-source rule).
bank-bins.coverage: 39 BINs; banks that merged or renamed keep the name at assignment time

sheba-banks.what: Sheba (IBAN) bank identifier to bank name
sheba-banks.publisher: Central Bank of Iran national IBAN specification (published by Bank Melli Iran) for 19 codes; two agreeing public sources for the rest.

national-code-locations.what: First 3 digits of the national code to province and city of issue
national-code-locations.publisher: No official machine-readable list. A prefix needs agreement of the sources named in SOURCES.md.
national-code-locations.coverage: 547 prefixes; the place of issue, not of birth or residence

iran-official-holidays.what: Dates of the Islamic-calendar public holidays per Jalali year
iran-official-holidays.publisher: Calendar Center, Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran (official yearly tables); time.ir per-day pages and a news list for the reported years.
iran-official-holidays.coverage: Jalali years 1380 to 1405: official for 1394 and 1396 to 1405, reported (single source) for 1380 to 1393 and 1395

umm-al-qura.what: Umm al-Qura month lengths, one entry per Hijri year
umm-al-qura.publisher: KACST Umm Al-Qura Calendar (checked month by month for AH 1318 to 1500); ICU/CLDR islamic-umalqura data (generated) for AH 1300 to 1317.
